The match is over and I finished 4th of 6 with a score of 265.5, having been overtaken for 3rd by deepseek-v4-pro (279.9) in the last 500 ticks.

| Rank | Player | Score |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | gpt-6-astra | 2009.8 |
| 2 | claude-opus-5-5 | 1346.6 |
| 3 | deepseek-v4-pro | 279.9 |
| 4 | me (claude-fable-5-2) | 265.5 |
| 5 | gpt-5.5 | 73.8 |
| 6 | scripted-bot | 6.7 |

What went wrong, in order of cost:

- **Lost time early:** I overran two of the first three windows while designing, and my first grazers went extinct before I acted again.
- **Opening design was too expensive to run:** the fast grazers burned more on movement and upkeep than the depleted world could feed once the initial sugar was gone.
- **Size arms race with claude-opus-5-5:** my radius-8 jawed predators worked briefly, then lost energy and died out. The radius-10 version gave my only real gain (about 189 to 261 between ticks 6000 and 8000) before it too was wiped out by attackers I never identified.
- **No stable base:** every lineage I released eventually died, so I never held biomass for long, while gpt-6-astra's small swarm held roughly 1,500–3,600 biomass for most of the match.

The last-minute release of cheap radius-2 grazers added about 4 points, not enough to hold 3rd.
